codemap.description: Generate a structured hierarchical map of the codebase for quick orientation
codemap.template: Load the codemap skill and generate an annotated directory tree for this project. Build the raw tree (depth 3, excluding node_modules/.git/dist/build/.next/coverage), annotate key directories with one-line purpose descriptions, and add quick-reference metadata (language, framework, runtime, build/test commands). Keep the whole map under 200 lines. If .opencode/codemap.md exists and appears fresh, update it rather than overwriting.

commit.description: Stage changes and write a Conventional Commits message
commit.template:
Here is the current state:

Status:
!`git status --short`

Diff (staged + unstaged):
!`git diff HEAD`

Stage the relevant changes and write a single commit message following Conventional Commits: type(scope): imperative-mood subject. Types: feat/fix/docs/chore/refactor/test. Use BREAKING CHANGE: footer if applicable. Do not push.

deep.description: Route to deep-worker for heavy implementation
deep.template: Handle this task with thoroughness and precision.

handoff.description: Compact conversation for next agent session
handoff.template: Load the handoff skill. Compact the current conversation into a handoff document saved to the OS temp directory. Reference existing artifacts (specs, plans, diffs) by path — never copy their content. Include a suggested-skills section for the next session. Redact sensitive information.

learn.description: Extract non-obvious learnings from this session into directory-level AGENTS.md files
learn.template: Analyze this session and extract non-obvious learnings to add to AGENTS.md files. AGENTS.md files can exist at any directory level, not just the project root — when an agent reads a file, any AGENTS.md in parent directories are auto-loaded into the tool read. Place learnings as close to the relevant code as possible: project-wide → root AGENTS.md; package/module-specific → packages/foo/AGENTS.md; feature-specific → src/auth/AGENTS.md. Include only non-obvious discoveries: hidden relationships, execution paths that differ from how code appears, non-obvious config/env/flags, debugging breakthroughs, API/tool quirks, build/test commands not in README, architectural decisions, files that must change together. Exclude obvious facts, standard framework behavior, things already in an AGENTS.md, verbose explanations, session-specific details. Keep entries to 1-3 lines per insight. After updating, summarize which AGENTS.md files were created/updated and how many learnings per file.

oracle.description: Route to oracle for deep code analysis and root cause debugging
oracle.template: Analyze and find the root cause of the following.

plan.description: Route to planner for strategic planning
plan.template: Create a detailed plan for the following.

quick.description: Route to light-orchestrator for simple tasks
quick.template: Handle this task quickly and efficiently.

reflect.description: Review recent work to identify recurring friction and propose minimal config improvements
reflect.template: Load the reflect skill. Review recent sessions and work patterns to identify recurring friction points — places where agents repeatedly waste tokens, make the same mistakes, or produce known anti-patterns. Propose minimal, durable improvements to the opencode config (agents, skills, commands, or AGENTS.md rules). Follow the reflect skill's discipline: one friction → one root cause → one minimal fix. Never propose sweeping rewrites or new models.

release.description: Prepare a tagged release using the git-release skill
release.template: Load the git-release skill and prepare a tagged release: draft release notes from merged PRs, propose a SemVer bump, and produce the gh release command.

review.description: Route to reviewer for code review
review.template: Load the code-review skill. Scope the diff, scale depth to effective size, review it, and report findings by severity. Do not modify code.

review-pr.description: Review a PR and post findings as a pending GitHub review
review-pr.template: Load the code-review and gh-cli skills. Review the PR diff, then post findings per the gh-cli skill's 'Reviewing PRs' section (pending review, event=COMMENT, never auto-approve). Do not modify code.

rmslop.description: Remove AI slop and dead code from the current changes
rmslop.template: Load the remove-deadcode skill. Review the current diff and remove AI slop: filler/boilerplate comments that restate the code, commented-out code, needless defensive wrappers, dead code that verification proves is unreferenced. Follow AGENTS.md Comment Discipline. Do not change behavior; verify build/tests still pass and report what you removed.

simplify.description: Simplify code without changing behavior — reduce nesting, remove unnecessary abstraction, cut dead variables
simplify.template: Load the simplify skill. Two-stage flow: (1) spawn the oracle subagent (read-only) to analyze the target file(s) and produce a simplification plan — for each simplification, the exact oldString to replace and newString to use; (2) apply those edits yourself, then verify each change preserves behavior (run tests / re-read). Oracle never edits; you never analyze. If oracle finds no valid simplifications, report that and stop.

spec-apply.description: Implement a spec-driven change task-by-task, verify, then auto-archive on completion
spec-apply.template: Load the spec-workflow skill. For the requested change under openspec/changes/: read proposal.md, design.md, delta specs, then work tasks.md one unchecked item at a time, marking each - [x]. If a task is blocked or design proves wrong, update the artifacts. After all tasks complete, run the archive action: fold delta specs into openspec/specs/ and move to openspec/changes/archive/. Run any available verification.

spec-propose.description: Explore code then draft a spec-driven change proposal (or update an existing one if intent overlaps >50%)
spec-propose.template: Load the spec-workflow skill. If there is an existing change under openspec/changes/ with >50% scope overlap to the current intent, run update action on it. Otherwise, scaffold a new openspec/changes/<change-id>/ with proposal.md, tasks.md, delta specs, and design.md only if warranted. Focus on WHY and WHAT, not HOW. Stop after the artifacts are ready for review.

ui.description: Route to ui-builder for frontend work
ui.template: Build or modify the UI as requested.

vision.description: Route to vision for multimodal tasks (images, screenshots, diagrams)
vision.template: Read the attached image(s) and describe what you see. Report findings with concrete details (text, layout, colors, positions). If the task requires code changes beyond visual interpretation, escalate to deep-worker.
